title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks

translated_title: OA-RAG：基于本体的智能体RAG，用于忠实的大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在许多现实世界任务中表现良好，但仍然容易产生幻觉，这限制了它们在生物医学和医疗保健等领域的可靠性，因为这些领域的答案必须建立在已有知识的基础之上。检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部信息来缓解这一问题，但往往忽视逻辑关系，并且严重依赖大语言模型自身的推理，这可能损害答案的忠实性。我们提出了OA-RAG，这是一个将形式化推理与大语言模型推理相结合的智能体，它同时利用领域本体的逻辑结构和非形式化注释。对于每个答案，OA-RAG会报告用作证据的本体观察结果，以及一个由模型评估的依据水平（可推导、受支持、相关或不相关），用以刻画该证据的强度。在基于三个大规模本体和六个真实世界医学问答任务构建的基准测试上
tldr: 该论文提出OA-RAG，一种基于本体的智能体RAG方法，将形式化推理与大语言模型推理相结合，并通过报告本体证据观察和模型评估的依据水平，提升医学问答中答案的忠实性。
en_tdlr: OA-RAG is an ontology-based agentic RAG framework that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, reporting ontology evidence observations and model-assessed grounding levels to enhance answer faithfulness in medical question answering.
